citation:
Hand-written, not a published protocol.

Authored for the vertical slice and the offline tests so the build has a corpus
before the real one lands in Task 19. Its step is modelled on the shape of a
high-fidelity PCR setup but is not taken from any source and must never appear
in an evidence table.

The three cited protocols are in Task 19: the NEB Q5 High-Fidelity PCR protocol
(M0491), the Addgene bacterial transformation protocol, and an adherent-cell
passaging protocol.
